lines.zh: 背上的帆一扇一扇地起伏。
lines.en: The sail on my back rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我贴着河岸走，脚爪陷进沙里。
lines.en: I follow the bank, claws sinking into sand.
Four short legs carry my long body.
Fish by the water; I shift over slowly.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着我的帆，暖得刚好。
lines.en: Sun warms my sail, just right.
I step around a wet stone.

lines.zh: 二叠纪的泥地，还是这个味。
lines.en: Permian mud still smells the same.
I keep my head down, searching for water.
Three-toed prints, all uneven.
I'm not fast, but I last.

lines.zh: 岸边的草被压出一条路。
lines.en: The bank grass parts into a path.
I stop at the shallows to hear the water.
A shake of my sail sends the water flying.
My belly rides almost on the ground.
I walk the line of a fallen log.
That hollow ahead; I test it with one foot.
This stretch needs no effort at all.
I raise my sail toward the sun.
I lie flat and lift only my head.
A ripple on the water; the fish is gone.
The shades on my sail shift slowly.
Wind crosses my spine, pleasant.
I wait for a fish to swim close.

lines.zh: 爪子搭在石头上，晒太阳。
lines.en: One claw on a stone, basking.

lines.zh: 呼吸缓下来，我半闭着眼。
lines.en: Breathing slows; my eyes half close.
Bubbles rise out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我不动，像一块有脊的岩。
lines.en: Still, I look like a rock with a ridge.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖轻轻拍了一下水。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the water once.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在叫，我不理。
lines.en: Something calls far off; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 帆的边缘被风吹得发颤。
lines.en: The sail's edge trembles in the wind.
I'll rest a while before going in.
I lift my head and the sail lifts with it.
You're much taller than I expected.
I smell fire on you.
These shallows are mine.
Your splashing is far too loud.
I open my mouth just enough to show teeth.
Want the water? Get past me.
I tilt my head at your shadow.
I flinch and my sail sags.
Pain runs down from my back.

lines.zh: 我往水里退，那里更安全。
lines.en: I retreat toward the water, safer there.
That one pulls a cry out of me.
I flatten down and fold the sail.
In mud my turning is slow.
I bare my teeth but don't charge.
Blood spreads on the water's surface.
I pant, and the sail rises and falls.
A fishy smell drifts over.
Set the fish down and I won't chase.
The smell of water stirs me.

lines.zh: 背帆一热，我就朝鱼腥味挪过去。
lines.en: The moment my sail warms, I shuffle toward the smell of fish.

lines.zh: 先让我闻闻是不是活的。
lines.en: Let me check if it's fresh.
I open my mouth, then close it.
This is not a fish I know.
Step back half and I'll come near.
My sail is up; I'm eager.
Only what comes from water will do.
You bump into the rim of my sail.
The shove turns me half aside.
I'm long; making room is awkward.
We crowd the narrow bank.
I duck and slip through.

lines.zh: 湿泥让我们都滑了一下。
lines.en: Wet mud slides us both.
I nudge your shin, not hard.
Only one body fits here.
We collide and water sprays up.

lines.zh: 我抬高帆，让她看清花纹。
lines.en: I raise my sail to show her the pattern.
She circles the shallows once.
We bask side by side, sails out.
I push my catch toward her.

lines.zh: 尾巴搭在一起，像打了结。
lines.en: Our tails rest together like a knot.
She stays; I stay.
There's room on this bank for two.
I brush her neck with my snout.

lines.zh: 风把我们的帆吹向一边。
lines.en: The wind leans both our sails the same way.
We both turn our heads to the water.
This fish fell on the mud.
I take it and turn away.
The bone is greasy and rich.
A wet log; not much use.
I hold it down with a front claw.
It's slippery; three tries.
Shiny things I can't carry well.
I drag the fish behind a stone.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我走得更慢。
lines.en: Carrying it, I move slower.
The smell gets up into my nose.

lines.zh: 水面动了一下，我盯住了。
lines.en: The water moved; I have it.
This smell is alive.
I turn with my sail raised.
Too small for a mouthful.
I sink low and ease to the shallows.
Front feet first, hind feet after.
It's swimming shoreward; perfect.
My teeth click on nothing.
This time I'll be more exact.

lines.zh: 风把水纹吹乱了，我等着。
lines.en: The wind ruffles the water; I wait.
I track along the shallows.
The shadow under the surface is slow.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，堵住退路。
lines.en: I change angle and cut off the retreat.
The mud steadies my feet.

lines.zh: 它浮上来换气，被我看见。
lines.en: It surfaces for air; I see it.
I count its wriggling.
The sail tightens along my back.
It heads deeper; I follow in.
Water climbs to my belly.
I bite down and wrench my head.
The claw pins it; the teeth follow.
I swallow the whole fish.
This strike throws water everywhere.
It slips free; I bite again.

lines.zh: 我的帆在扑击时抖了一下。
lines.en: My sail snaps once as I lunge.
Blunt teeth, but the jaw is strong.
I strike upward from below.
It rolls belly-up and floats.
I drag it ashore to eat.
A new shadow appears in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我背上的帆先露出水面。
lines.en: My sail breaks the water first.
New prints press into the bank.
I squeeze out from between the stones.
Heavy with damp; this suits me.
I lift my head and look around.
The water here is warm.
I shake the water off my sail.
I don't know that far wood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬上岸，先晒一晒。
lines.en: I climb ashore and bask a while.
The fish here smell decent.
I pick the flattest stretch of bank.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到帆边，我疼得打滚。
lines.en: Flame licks my sail's edge; I roll in pain.

lines.zh: 摔落时我的肚皮被砸得发闷。
lines.en: The fall slams the breath out of my belly.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的头抬不起来了。
lines.en: The water is too deep; I can't lift my head.
The blast throws me up onto the bank.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的帆里。
lines.en: A sharp point sticks through my sail.

lines.zh: 有看不见的力量把我压向地面。
lines.en: Unseen force presses me to the ground.

lines.zh: 饿得我的帆都垂下来了。
lines.en: Hunger makes my sail hang loose.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，四肢全木了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; my limbs go wooden.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一路下沉。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I sink endlessly.
